title.zh: 时尚 lookbook 与人像写真片

description.en: One person, one look, a handful of places: a head-to-toe appearance lock carries the clip, each scene gets one location, one gesture and one light.
description.zh: 一个人、一身造型、几个地点：从头写到脚的外观锁撑起整条片子，每个场景只给一个地点、一个动作、一种光。

description.en: Compress making or transformation into a readable story with a clear start, continuous steps, and end state.
description.zh: 用明确起点、连续步骤和终态，把制作或变化过程压缩成可读叙事。

description.en: Every beat serves one punchline that lands on something visible; absurd setups shot with a straight-faced camera.
description.zh: 所有节拍都为一个笑点服务，笑点落在看得见的东西上，荒诞设定配一本正经的镜头。

description.en: A recurring twist-ending comedy skit method derived from 4 published cases by Ciri_ai.
description.zh: 从 Ciri_ai 的 4 个已发布 Case 中归纳出的「反转搞笑短片」方法。

description.en: Every shot carries its own timecode and one visible change on a body; dread comes from the chain, and the ending seals a door without settling anything.
description.zh: 每一镜带自己的时间码，身上只发生一个看得见的变化；吓人的地方在于变化一环扣一环，结尾把门关上不了结。

description.en: A recurring horror and suspense short method derived from 7 published cases by doctorwasif.
description.zh: 从 doctorwasif 的 7 个已发布 Case 中归纳出的「恐怖悬疑短片」方法。

description.en: A recurring horror and suspense short method derived from 5 published cases by AIwithSynthia.
description.zh: 从 AIwithSynthia 的 5 个已发布 Case 中归纳出的「恐怖悬疑短片」方法。

description.en: A recurring horror and suspense short method derived from 3 published cases by auqibhabib.
description.zh: 从 auqibhabib 的 3 个已发布 Case 中归纳出的「恐怖悬疑短片」方法。

description.en: Cooking close-ups, mukbang and eating vlogs. They work when every beat shows one visible change in the food and one matching sound, and the dish stays the same dish from first frame to last.
description.zh: 烹饪特写、吃播和吃东西的 vlog。成立靠的是每一拍都让食物发生一个看得见的变化，再配上对应的一个声音，而且这道菜从头到尾都是同一道菜。

description.en: It all rides on the action loop: write every link from run-up to landing in order, name the physics you want by part, and spend the negative list on flying, hovering and teleporting.
description.zh: 全押在动作闭环上：从助跑到落地按顺序写出来，要哪几项物理就点名哪几项，负面清单专门打掉飞行、悬浮和瞬移。

description.en: One appealing character carries the clip: a parts-list design lock, a measurable render look, and one action goal per timeline block.
description.zh: 一个拟人小角色撑起整条片子：外形逐项写死，画风写成可测量的渲染项，时间轴一段一个动作目标。

description.en: A recurring 3d cartoon character short method derived from 8 published cases by Zarnab_with_Ai.
description.zh: 从 Zarnab_with_Ai 的 8 个已发布 Case 中归纳出的「3D 卡通角色短片」方法。

description.en: One machine from first frame to last while the camera does the work: lock the vehicle part by part, then fill the runtime with a numbered cut list that moves every second.
description.zh: 机器从头到尾是同一台，出力的是镜头：先按部件锁车，再用编号分镜表把时长排满，每秒换机位。

description.en: Compress a dramatic beat into 15 to 30 seconds with character stakes, an emotional turn, and film grammar.
description.zh: 用人物关系、情绪转折和电影镜头语言，把一段剧情压进十几秒到半分钟。

description.en: Choreograph stage, dance, and cut points to the beat for idol stages, dance covers, and music shorts.
description.zh: 按节拍编排舞台、舞蹈和剪辑点，做出偶像舞台、翻跳或音乐短片。

description.en: Two stages: first a single sheet of numbered panels from an image model, then that sheet fed to Seedance as the reference; order, framing and timing live on the sheet.
description.zh: 两步走：先用图像模型出一张带编号格子的分镜图，再把它当参考喂给 Seedance；顺序、构图和时长由分镜图定死。

description.en: Have an AI write recordable HTML, Three.js, or SVG animation for explainers, data motion, and product demos.
description.zh: 让 AI 用 HTML、Three.js 或 SVG 写出可录制的动画，做讲解片、数据动画和产品演示。

title.en: Gameplay capture with HUD and stream overlay
title.zh: 游戏实机录屏与直播叠层

description.en: The screen itself is the shot: a fake gameplay capture, livestream or desktop recording. It holds up when the overlay layer is pinned to fixed positions and its numbers and banners change in step with the action.
description.zh: 屏幕本身就是画面，假装是一段游戏实机、直播或桌面录屏。成立的关键是叠层钉死在固定位置，上面的数字和横幅跟着剧情一格一格变。
